tasks.title: Phase 1: MUXI LLM & Core Foundation
tasks.description: Implement a unified LLM interface and replace current provider implementations
tasks.details: Create a standalone MUXI LLM package that provides a consistent interface for all LLM providers, with unified handling for streaming, retries, caching, and fallbacks. Then refactor existing code to use this package.
tasks.testStrategy: Comprehensive tests for all supported providers, ensuring compatibility with existing functionality.

subtasks.title: Complete MUXI LLM Core Implementation
subtasks.description: Build the core interface and abstract classes for the MUXI LLM package
subtasks.details: Create a standardized interface that all LLM providers will implement, including support for streaming responses, proper error handling, retry mechanisms, and cost tracking.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for core functionality with mock providers.

subtasks.title: Implement Provider-Specific Adaptations
subtasks.description: Create adapters for each supported LLM provider
subtasks.details: Implement provider-specific classes for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini/VertexAI, xAI, Azure OpenAI, HuggingFace, Openrouter, Ollama, Amazon Bedrock, and NVIDIA.
subtasks.testStrategy: Integration tests for each provider with real API calls (using limited tokens).

subtasks.title: Build Model Router for Fallbacks
subtasks.description: Create a system for routing between different LLM providers
subtasks.details: Implement a model router that can select providers based on priority, cost, and availability, with automatic fallback on errors.
subtasks.testStrategy: Scenario tests with simulated provider failures to verify fallback behavior.

subtasks.title: Refactor Existing Providers to Use MUXI LLM
subtasks.description: Update the current framework code to use the new MUXI LLM package
subtasks.details: Replace direct provider implementation with imports from the MUXI LLM package, ensuring all existing functionality continues to work.
subtasks.testStrategy: Regression tests comparing responses before and after the refactoring.

subtasks.title: Update Documentation for MUXI LLM
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive documentation for the new LLM interface
subtasks.details: Document the MUXI LLM interface, provider implementations, configuration options, and migration guide for existing code.
subtasks.testStrategy: Documentation review and example code verification.

tasks.title: Phase 2: Multi-Modal Capabilities
tasks.description: Add support for document, image, and audio processing with tight integration into MUXI LLM
tasks.details: Implement support for document, image, and audio processing, with tight integration into the MUXI LLM package to enable multi-modal agent interactions.
tasks.testStrategy: Multi-modal scenario tests with various content types and interactions.

subtasks.title: Implement Document Processing
subtasks.description: Add support for PDF and Office documents
subtasks.details: Create processors for PDF, Office documents, and other text formats, with OCR for scanned documents and summarization capabilities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tests with various document types and formats.

subtasks.title: Add Image Processing
subtasks.description: Implement image handling and analysis
subtasks.details: Build support for image processing, including preprocessing, format conversion, and integration with vision-capable LLM models.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tests with different image types, formats, and content scenarios.

subtasks.title: Develop Audio Processing
subtasks.description: Create audio handling and speech capabilities
subtasks.details: Implement audio processing with speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and audio analysis capabilities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tests with various audio formats, languages, and quality levels.

subtasks.title: Integrate Multi-Modal with MUXI LLM
subtasks.description: Tie multi-modal capabilities into the core LLM package
subtasks.details: Extend the MUXI LLM interface to support multi-modal content in both inputs and outputs, with proper handling across different model capabilities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Integration tests across different model types with multi-modal content.

subtasks.title: Create Multi-Modal Memory Support
subtasks.description: Update memory systems for non-text content
subtasks.details: Enhance buffer and long-term memory systems to store and retrieve multi-modal content appropriately.
subtasks.testStrategy: Memory tests with mixed-modal content types.

tasks.title: Phase 3: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Communication
tasks.description: Implement the A2A protocol for structured communication between agents
tasks.details: Create a standardized protocol for agents to communicate, discover capabilities, and delegate tasks while maintaining proper context isolation and security.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests with multiple agents communicating to solve complex tasks.

subtasks.title: Design A2A Communication Protocol
subtasks.description: Create specifications for the A2A message format and protocol
subtasks.details: Define the message structure, capability format, authentication mechanisms, and conversation lifecycle for inter-agent communication.
subtasks.testStrategy: Protocol specification review and sample message validation.

subtasks.title: Implement Capability Discovery
subtasks.description: Build the system for agents to register and discover capabilities
subtasks.details: Create a registry where agents can publish their capabilities and query other agents' capabilities, with metadata about inputs, outputs, and constraints.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tests for capability registration, discovery, and querying with multiple agent types.

subtasks.title: Create Context Sharing Mechanism
subtasks.description: Implement secure context sharing between agents
subtasks.details: Build a system for agents to share relevant context with other agents while maintaining proper isolation of sensitive information.
subtasks.testStrategy: Security tests ensuring proper context isolation and information control.

subtasks.title: Develop Task Delegation System
subtasks.description: Create the infrastructure for agents to delegate tasks
subtasks.details: Implement mechanisms for agents to delegate tasks to other agents based on their capabilities, with proper tracking and result handling.
subtasks.testStrategy: End-to-end tests for complex task delegation scenarios.

subtasks.title: Build A2A Security Layer
subtasks.description: Implement security controls for inter-agent communication
subtasks.details: Create authentication, authorization, and auditing systems for A2A communication, with configurable permissions and rate limiting.
subtasks.testStrategy: Security testing for unauthorized access attempts and permission enforcement.

tasks.title: Phase 4: Overlord Overlord
tasks.description: Transform the overlord into an advanced system for task decomposition and workflow management
tasks.details: Enhance the current overlord to automatically decompose complex tasks, construct and manage workflows, and intelligently distribute work among specialized agents.
tasks.testStrategy: Complex scenario tests with multi-stage workflows and error recovery.

subtasks.title: Design Task Decomposition System
subtasks.description: Create the architecture for breaking down complex tasks
subtasks.details: Design prompt templates and reasoning mechanisms for analyzing complex user requests and breaking them down into logical subtasks with dependencies.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tests with various complex queries to verify decomposition quality.

subtasks.title: Implement Agent Capability Registry
subtasks.description: Build a registry of agent capabilities for task assignment
subtasks.details: Integrate with the A2A capability discovery to maintain a registry of available agents and their capabilities for intelligent task routing.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tests for capability matching between tasks and agents.

subtasks.title: Create Workflow Management System
subtasks.description: Implement a DAG-based workflow engine
subtasks.details: Build a system for constructing, executing, and monitoring directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of subtasks, with proper dependency handling and data flow.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tests for complex workflows with various dependency patterns.

subtasks.title: Develop Self-Correction Mechanism
subtasks.description: Implement error detection and workflow adjustment
subtasks.details: Create a system that can detect execution failures, errors in agent outputs, or logical inconsistencies, and dynamically adjust the workflow to recover.
subtasks.testStrategy: Failure scenario tests with various error types and recovery paths.

subtasks.title: Integrate with A2A Communication
subtasks.description: Connect the Overlord to the A2A system
subtasks.details: Use the A2A protocol for task delegation and result collection within the Overlord's workflow management system.
subtasks.testStrategy: End-to-end tests with complex workflows spanning multiple agents.

tasks.title: Phase 5: Service & API Development
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive API and interface layers
tasks.details: Build out the REST API, SSE streaming, WebRTC support, CLI tools, and web UI for interacting with MUXI, with proper authentication and security controls.
tasks.testStrategy: Comprehensive API tests and usability testing across interfaces.

subtasks.title: Complete REST API Implementation
subtasks.description: Finalize the HTTP-based API endpoints
subtasks.details: Implement all endpoints from the API specification, including agent management, memory operations, conversation handling, and system monitoring.
subtasks.testStrategy: API tests for all endpoints with various request scenarios.

subtasks.title: Implement SSE Streaming
subtasks.description: Build the server-sent events streaming layer
subtasks.details: Create an SSE interface for streaming responses token-by-token, with proper connection handling and resumption capabilities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Streaming connection tests with various message types and reconnection scenarios.

subtasks.title: Add WebRTC Support
subtasks.description: Implement audio/video communication
subtasks.details: Set up WebRTC signaling and handling for real-time audio/video interactions with agents.
subtasks.testStrategy: WebRTC connection tests across various network conditions and browsers.

subtasks.title: Enhance CLI Interface
subtasks.description: Improve the command-line tools
subtasks.details: Expand the CLI to support all API operations, with improved formatting, color support, and configuration management.
subtasks.testStrategy: CLI command tests across various operations.

subtasks.title: Develop Web UI
subtasks.description: Create a browser-based interface
subtasks.details: Build a responsive web interface for agent interaction, configuration management, and system monitoring using modern web technologies.
subtasks.testStrategy: UI tests across various browsers and device sizes.

subtasks.title: Implement Authentication System
subtasks.description: Create a secure authentication layer
subtasks.details: Build a dual-key authentication system with user and admin keys, supporting proper validation, rotation, and security controls.
subtasks.testStrategy: Security tests for authentication mechanisms and access control.

tasks.title: Phase 6: MUXI as a Service
tasks.description: Create containerized deployment with unified configuration
tasks.details: Develop a Docker-based deployment option with unified YAML configuration and persistence for agent settings, enabling easy setup and management.
tasks.testStrategy: Deployment tests across various environments and configurations.

subtasks.title: Create Docker Container
subtasks.description: Build a containerized version of MUXI
subtasks.details: Create a Docker container with pre-configured MUXI and all dependencies, optimized for production deployment.
subtasks.testStrategy: Container tests across different host environments.

subtasks.title: Implement Unified YAML Configuration
subtasks.description: Create a single configuration file format
subtasks.details: Design and implement a comprehensive YAML configuration format that can define an entire MUXI application, including all agents, memory settings, and infrastructure.
subtasks.testStrategy: Configuration tests with various complexity levels and settings.

subtasks.title: Build Configuration Persistence
subtasks.description: Create storage for agent configurations
subtasks.details: Implement a persistence layer for storing and versioning agent configurations, with change tracking and backup capabilities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Persistence tests with configuration changes and versioning.

subtasks.title: Develop SDK Generator
subtasks.description: Create tools for language-specific clients
subtasks.details: Build a system for generating language-specific SDKs based on the API specification, with consistent developer experience across languages.
subtasks.testStrategy: Generated SDK tests in various language environments.

subtasks.title: Create Administrative Interface
subtasks.description: Build management tools for MUXI as a Service
subtasks.details: Implement CLI and web-based tools for managing MUXI deployments, including agent configuration, monitoring, and user management.
subtasks.testStrategy: Administrative interface tests with various management scenarios.

tasks.title: Phase 7: Language-Specific SDKs
tasks.description: Develop client libraries for various programming languages
tasks.details: Create SDKs for TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java/Kotlin, Rust, C#/.NET, PHP, and Ruby, providing a consistent developer experience across languages.
tasks.testStrategy: SDK tests in each language environment with various use cases.
